careers.title: Python Developer
careers.description: Builds software, automation scripts and backend services using Python.
projects: Command line expense tracker
REST API for a to-do list
Web scraper that saves results to CSV

fundamentals: Learn Python syntax, variables, loops and functions
Practise problem solving with small daily exercises
core_skills: Study object oriented programming, modules and packages
Learn Git, SQL basics and how to build REST APIs
projects: Build a command line tool and a small REST API
Add unit tests to every project
portfolio: Publish projects on GitHub with clear README files
Write short notes explaining your design decisions
interview: Practise Python coding questions and explain your projects aloud
Revise OOP, data structures and debugging approaches

careers.title: Data Analyst
careers.description: Collects, cleans and analyses data to answer business questions and presents findings through reports and dashboards.
projects: Sales dashboard from a public CSV
Exploratory analysis of a student performance dataset
SQL report on a sample database

fundamentals: Learn spreadsheet formulas, pivot tables and basic statistics
Understand data types, tables and simple SQL queries
core_skills: Learn Python with Pandas for cleaning and analysing data
Practise data visualization and build dashboards in a BI tool
projects: Clean and analyse a real public dataset
Build a dashboard that answers three business questions
portfolio: Publish notebooks and dashboards with a short written insight summary
Describe the question, method and finding for each project
interview: Practise SQL query questions and statistics basics
Prepare to walk through one analysis from raw data to insight

careers.title: Machine Learning Engineer
careers.description: Designs, trains, evaluates and deploys machine learning models for real applications.
projects: Spam message classifier
Image classifier with a small neural network
House price prediction with model evaluation

fundamentals: Strengthen Python, NumPy and basic linear algebra and probability
Learn how supervised and unsupervised learning differ
core_skills: Practise scikit-learn models, feature engineering and evaluation metrics
Learn deep learning with TensorFlow or PyTorch
projects: Train and compare models on a public dataset
Wrap a trained model in a simple web app or API
portfolio: Document each project with data, method, metrics and limitations
Publish code and results on GitHub
interview: Revise bias, variance, overfitting and evaluation metrics
Prepare to explain every step of one end-to-end project

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.description: Uses statistics, programming and machine learning to extract insight and build predictive solutions from data.
projects: Customer churn prediction
A/B test analysis on sample data
Exploratory study of an open government dataset

fundamentals: Learn Python, descriptive statistics and probability
Practise SQL for extracting data
core_skills: Learn Pandas, visualization and hypothesis testing
Study machine learning models and how to evaluate them
projects: Complete an end-to-end analysis with a predictive model
Present results with clear charts and conclusions
portfolio: Publish notebooks that tell a clear data story
Write short case studies describing problem, approach and result
interview: Practise statistics, probability and SQL questions
Prepare to explain model choices and trade-offs

careers.title: Web Developer
careers.description: Creates websites and web applications, covering both what users see and how the server behaves.
projects: Personal portfolio website
Weather app using a public API
Task manager web app

fundamentals: Learn HTML and CSS and build static pages
Understand how browsers, servers and HTTP work
core_skills: Learn JavaScript, responsive layouts and Git
Pick a framework such as React and learn to call APIs
projects: Build a multi-page responsive site
Build an app that stores and displays data
portfolio: Host your projects and link them from a portfolio page
Keep code clean and documented on GitHub
interview: Practise JavaScript and CSS layout questions
Prepare to demo and explain one full web project

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.description: Protects systems and networks by monitoring for threats, assessing vulnerabilities and responding to incidents.
projects: Password strength checker
Home lab network scan report using safe, permitted targets
Log analysis script that flags suspicious activity

fundamentals: Learn networking basics and the Linux command line
Understand the core ideas of confidentiality, integrity and availability
core_skills: Study cryptography, common vulnerabilities and security tools
Learn scripting with Python to automate checks
projects: Practise only in legal labs and deliberately vulnerable practice environments
Write a short report for each lab you finish
portfolio: Publish write-ups of labs and defensive scripts
Document what you learned and how you would fix each issue
interview: Revise networking, common attacks and defensive controls
Prepare to explain one incident-response scenario step by step

careers.title: Cloud Engineer
careers.description: Designs, deploys and maintains applications and infrastructure on cloud platforms.
projects: Deploy a static website on a cloud storage service
Containerise a small app with Docker
Automate a deployment with a simple CI CD pipeline

fundamentals: Learn Linux, networking and how servers work
Understand what cloud computing and virtualization are
core_skills: Learn one major cloud platform and its core services
Learn Docker and infrastructure as code basics
projects: Deploy an app to the cloud using free tier or student credits
Set up an automated build and deploy pipeline
portfolio: Document architecture diagrams and deployment steps
Publish your configuration files on GitHub
interview: Revise cloud service models, networking and security basics
Prepare to explain how you deployed and monitored an application

careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.description: Designs, builds, tests and maintains software systems with a strong focus on algorithms and good engineering practice.
projects: Library management system
Chat application with a simple backend
Command line text editor

fundamentals: Learn a main language well and practise basic problem solving
Understand data structures and how code runs
core_skills: Study algorithms, object oriented design and databases
Learn Git workflows, testing and debugging
projects: Build a multi-feature application with tests
Contribute a small fix to an open-source project
portfolio: Keep clean repositories with documentation
Explain architecture choices in your README files
interview: Practise data structure and algorithm problems regularly
Revise object oriented design and basic system design

careers.title: UI/UX Designer
careers.description: Designs usable, attractive interfaces by understanding users, sketching flows and building prototypes.
projects: Redesign a mobile app screen flow
Wireframes and prototype for a student portal
Usability test of a small website with five users

fundamentals: Learn design principles, color and typography
Understand the difference between user experience and user interface
core_skills: Learn Figma, wireframing and prototyping
Practise user research and usability testing
projects: Redesign an existing app and explain your reasoning
Run a small usability test and record findings
portfolio: Present two or three case studies showing problem, process and result
Publish them on a simple portfolio site
interview: Prepare to present a case study clearly
Practise explaining design decisions and handling feedback

careers.title: Business Analyst
careers.description: Connects business needs with technical teams by gathering requirements, analysing processes and documenting solutions.
projects: Requirements document for a college app
Process flow diagram for an admission workflow
Dashboard of business metrics from sample data

fundamentals: Learn basic business concepts and how projects are organised
Practise clear writing and structured communication
core_skills: Learn requirements gathering, user stories and process modeling
Build Excel and SQL skills for analysing data
projects: Write requirements for a small system and review them with a peer
Create process diagrams and a metrics dashboard
portfolio: Collect your documents and diagrams as sample deliverables
Explain the problem and outcome for each
interview: Practise case-style questions and requirement-clarifying questions
Prepare examples of communicating with different stakeholders
